name: Korea International Circuit
notes: Korea International Circuit, Grand Prix layout (anticlockwise). Via route over the single OSM way 'YEONGAM F1 Track'. It is not oneway, so the via points set the direction. Traced 5524 m vs 5615 m. Start line from the middle of the GP pit lane. One DRS zone on the long back straight from Turn 2 to Turn 3 as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
